views.name: sales_enriched
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.prod_id AS prod_id,
  s.cust_id AS cust_id,
  s.time_id AS time_id,
  s.channel_id AS channel_id,
  s.promo_id AS promo_id,
  s.quantity_sold AS quantity_sold,
  s.amount_sold AS amount_sold,
  p.prod_name AS prod_name,
  p.prod_subcategory AS prod_subcategory,
  p.prod_category AS prod_category,
  p.prod_list_price AS prod_list_price,
  c.cust_first_name AS cust_first_name,
  c.cust_last_name AS cust_last_name,
  c.cust_gender AS cust_gender,
  c.cust_year_of_birth AS cust_year_of_birth,
  c.cust_city AS cust_city,
  c.country_id AS country_id,
  co.country_name AS country_name,
  t.calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  t.calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  ch.channel_desc AS channel_desc,
  ch.channel_class AS channel_class,
  pr.promo_name AS promo_name,
  pr.promo_category AS promo_category
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.prod_id = s.prod_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
LEFT JOIN countries co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
LEFT JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = s.promo_id
views.description: Denormalized sales-level relation: one row per sales transaction enriched with product, customer, time, channel, promotion and country attributes. Use for any analysis that needs facts (quantity_sold, amount_sold) alongside descriptive dimensions without repeatedly joining tables. | Use for: sales trends by product/category/time/channel/promotion; customer-level purchase summaries joined to demographics; mix analyses combining product attributes with channels and promos

views.name: sales_monthly_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.prod_id AS prod_id,
  t.calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  t.calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  ch.channel_id AS channel_id,
  ch.channel_desc AS channel_desc,
  s.promo_id AS promo_id,
  co.country_id AS country_id,
  co.country_name AS country_name,
  SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS total_quantity_sold,
  SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_amount_sold,
  COUNT(*) AS sales_row_count
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.prod_id = s.prod_id
LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
LEFT JOIN customers cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
LEFT JOIN countries co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
GROUP BY
  p.prod_id,
  t.calendar_month_desc,
  t.calendar_year,
  ch.channel_id,
  s.promo_id,
  co.country_id,
  ch.channel_desc,
  co.country_name
views.description: Aggregated monthly sales measures at product x calendar_month_desc x channel x promo x country granularity. Useful for time-series, trend, and KPI calculations. Exposes aggregated measures and counts for downstream rates/ratios. | Use for: monthly revenue and volume trends by product/category and channel; promo effectiveness by month and country; top products by monthly sales or quantity

views.name: customer_current_active
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_id AS cust_id,
  c.cust_first_name AS cust_first_name,
  c.cust_last_name AS cust_last_name,
  c.cust_gender AS cust_gender,
  c.cust_year_of_birth AS cust_year_of_birth,
  c.cust_city AS cust_city,
  c.country_id AS country_id,
  c.cust_credit_limit AS cust_credit_limit,
  c.cust_email AS cust_email,
  c.cust_eff_from AS cust_eff_from,
  c.cust_eff_to AS cust_eff_to,
  c.cust_valid AS cust_valid
FROM customers c
WHERE c.cust_valid = 'A' -- interpret 'A' as active
views.description: Cohort of customers filtered to currently-active (cust_valid indicates active rows) and latest effective record per cust_id by cust_eff_from. Useful when analyses should use the current customer attributes. | Use for: analysis requiring current customer demographics; joining active customers to recent sales; segmenting customer base by demographics for marketing

views.name: product_current_price
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.prod_id AS prod_id,
  p.prod_name AS prod_name,
  p.prod_subcategory AS prod_subcategory,
  p.prod_category AS prod_category,
  p.supplier_id AS supplier_id,
  p.prod_list_price AS prod_list_price,
  p.prod_min_price AS prod_min_price,
  p.prod_eff_from AS prod_eff_from,
  p.prod_eff_to AS prod_eff_to,
  p.prod_valid AS prod_valid
FROM products p
WHERE p.prod_valid = 'A'
views.description: Canonical product table selecting active/current product attributes. Filters to prod_valid='A' to represent the current effective product record and exposes prices for pricing analyses. | Use for: price elasticity and margin calculations; product assortments and catalog reporting; joining product attributes to sales or cost records

views.name: latest_costs_per_prod_channel_promo_time
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.prod_id AS prod_id,
  c.channel_id AS channel_id,
  c.promo_id AS promo_id,
  c.time_id AS time_id,
  c.unit_cost AS unit_cost,
  c.unit_price AS unit_price,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY c.prod_id, c.channel_id, c.promo_id
    ORDER BY c.time_id DESC
  ) AS recent_rank
FROM costs c
views.description: Pick the latest cost record per prod_id, channel_id, promo_id as of time_id using time ordering. Exposes unit_cost and unit_price and rank so downstream queries can select top N or latest rows by filtering on rank = 1. | Use for: margin and gross profit calculations using latest available costs; compare price vs cost by product/channel/promo; identify stale or missing cost records

views.name: currency_monthly_rates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  currency.country AS country,
  currency.year AS year,
  currency.month AS month,
  currency.to_us AS to_us
FROM currency currency
views.description: Normalized monthly exchange rates to USD per country/year/month. Use to convert amounts in local currency to USD or to trend exchange rates. Exposes to_us rate and preserves country/year/month for joins to aggregated time keys. | Use for: currency conversions for revenue/time-series normalization; merge exchange rates with monthly aggregates to compute USD sales
